title: Chemical and kinematic structure of extremely high-velocity molecular jets in the Serpens Main star-forming region
question: How do the EHV jet and slow outflow interact (outflow force content), and what is the chemical composition and spatial location of molecules in the slow wing, fast wing and EHV jet of Serpens Main outflows?

what.value: HIFI CO and water spectra and Gaussian component fits for SMM1

evidence.quote: The HIFI spectra are shown with the Gaussian offset component overlaid based on the fit from (cite: Kristensen2013).
the ratio of H$_{2}/{\rm CO} = 1.2 \times 10^4$ (cite: Frerking1982)
(cite: Downes2007) provide a multiplication factor that should be used to account for inclination (Table 6 in their paper)
Critical densities from (cite: Jansen1995) calculated in the optically thin limit

recipe.method: Self-calibrate on continuum, apply to lines, continuum subtract, tclean multiscale with hand masks, Briggs 0.5, 0.5 km/s channels
Examine spectra of several molecules by eye; C18O off-outflow spectra set inner slow-wing limit; fast wing from H2CO decrease and SiO/HCN enhancement; EHV from rise of CO and SiO at high velocity

recipe.goal: Column densities and abundances relative to CO
recipe.method: Optically thin LTE column density per pixel integrated over each velocity regime; average over pixels >3 sigma in hand-defined regions; abundance = N(X)/N(CO)
key_parameters: CO Tex = 75 K; SiO 9-47 K, H2CO 8-46 K, HCN 12-41 K from RADEX
RADEX grid: nH2 = 1e4-1e6 cm-3; Tkin = 75-700 K; dv = 10 km/s
assumptions: Optically thin emission; HCN abundances lower limits

recipe.method: Mass from N_tot with H2/CO, mu=2.8; velocity-weighted method M7 for mass loss rate; F_out = Mdot/R_lobe * vmax; fractions per velocity regime
assumptions: No inclination correction applied (factors 1.2-7.1 would change absolute but not relative values)

evidence.quote: Out of the five outflow sources observed, the EHV component is detected toward three sources.

answer_key.quantity: EHV contribution to total outflow force

evidence.quote: the contribution of the EHV jets to the total outflow force is between 5–40 % of the total outflow force.

answer_key.quantity: Ser-emb 8 (N) blueshifted EHV share of outflow force

evidence.quote: only for the blueshifted jet of Ser-emb 8 (N) the EHV contribution (45%) to the total outflow force is higher

answer_key.quantity: Molecular jet mass-loss rates (Ser-emb 8 (N), SMM1-a, SMM1-b)

evidence.quote: 7.0, 3.9, and 15.0  $\times$ 10$^{-7 }$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$ for Ser-emb 8 (N), SMM1-a, and SMM1-b
From ALMA CO  $2-1$ (slow + fast wing) we obtain 1.4 and 11  $\times$ 10$^{-4}$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$ km s$^{-1}$
It has a very small opening angle of 25$^\circ$
